         1                 P R O C E E D I N G S

         2                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

         3       The Senate will please come to order.

         4                  I ask everyone present to rise and

         5       recite with me the Pledge of Allegiance to our

         6       Flag.

         7                  (Whereupon, the assemblage recited

         8       the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

         9                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        10       In the absence of clergy, may we bow all our

        11       heads for a moment of silence.

        12                  (Whereupon, the assemblage

        13       respected a moment of silence.)

        14                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        15       Thank you.

        16                  Senator Smith.

        17                  SENATOR SMITH:    Yes, Madam

        18       President.  Is there a proclamation from the

        19       Governor Paterson at the desk?

        20                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        21       Yes, Senator Smith, there is a proclamation

        22       here at the desk.

        23                  The Secretary will read.

        24                  THE SECRETARY:    "Pursuant to the



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         5730



         1       power vested in me by Article IV, Section 3 of

         2       the Constitution, I hereby convene the Senate

         3       of the State of New York in Extraordinary

         4       Session, at the Capitol, in the City of

         5       Albany, on the ninth day of July, two thousand

         6       nine, at three o'clock p.m., for the purpose

         7       of considering legislation I will submit with

         8       respect to various subjects and acting on

         9       gubernatorial nominations.

        10                  "Given under my hand and the Privy

        11       Seal of the State in the City of Albany this

        12       seventh day of July in the year two thousand

        13       nine, by the Governor, David A. Paterson."

        14                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        15       The proclamation having been read, the Senate

        16       is in extraordinary session.

        17                  Senator Smith.

        18                  SENATOR SMITH:    Thank you, Madam

        19       President.

        20                  Would you please call on my

        21       colleague Senator Dean Skelos.

        22                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        23       Senator Skelos.

        24                  SENATOR SKELOS:    Thank you,



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         5731



         1       Senator Stewart-Cousins.

         2                  I'd like to once again remind all

         3       of our colleagues that we are here today in

         4       extraordinary session at the call of the

         5       Governor, but also by court order being

         6       required to convene.

         7                  Again, I must state for the record,

         8       despite some of the new news that's out there,

         9       that we do not move away from the vote that

        10       occurred on June 8th where a majority of this

        11       body voted to change leadership and elected

        12       Senator Espada as temporary president of the

        13       Senate and myself as majority leader.

        14                  That would mean that either Senator

        15       Espada, on the vote of June 8th, or myself are

        16       the only ones entitled to appoint a presiding

        17       officer and to go into extraordinary session.

        18                  I would also like to point out that

        19       last night the Governor attempted to appoint a

        20       Lieutenant Governor in violation of the

        21       Constitution.  We do not recognize any such

        22       appointment, and any attempt by a person

        23       claiming to be the Lieutenant Governor to

        24       convene and preside over any session of the



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         5732



         1       Senate is not valid.

         2                  Again, I would point out that

         3       whether it's extraordinary session or regular

         4       session, based upon the vote of June 8th and

         5       the rules that were instituted that day, only

         6       Senator Espada or myself are entitled to

         7       appoint a presiding officer and to proceed

         8       with the session.

         9                  So at this time I'd like to move to

        10       lay aside the agenda and move to adjourn this

        11       session sine die.

        12                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        13       Thank you, Senator Skelos.

        14                  Senator Smith.

        15                  SENATOR SMITH:    Thank you, Madam

        16       President.  Always good to see you.

        17                  Given that we will have no

        18       legislative activity going before us today, I

        19       ask that we adjourn this Extraordinary Session

        20       Number 18 sine die.

        21                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        22       Thank you, Senator Smith.

        23                  On motion of Senator Smith, this

        24       Extraordinary Session Number 18 stands

         1       adjourned sine die.
